units.rawText: —Because I believe in Persicaria.
units.displayText: —Because I believe in Persicaria.

spans.text: —Because I believe in Persicaria.

units.rawText: A razor-sharp arrowhead streaks past me.
units.displayText: A razor-sharp arrowhead streaks past me.

spans.text: A razor-sharp arrowhead streaks past me.

units.rawText: (Sigh) What a boring answer.
units.displayText: (Sigh) What a boring answer.

spans.text: (Sigh) What a boring answer.

units.rawText: Thanks to the effect which the operand black hole has on Angelus, I've managed to keep her occupied for several minutes.
units.displayText: Thanks to the effect which the operand black hole has on Angelus, I've managed to keep her occupied for several minutes.

spans.text: Thanks to the effect which the operand black hole has on Angelus, I've managed to keep her occupied for several minutes.

units.rawText: Maybe she's deliberately going easy on me, but every time I dodge, I feel like there won't be a next time for me.
units.displayText: Maybe she's deliberately going easy on me, but every time I dodge, I feel like there won't be a next time for me.

spans.text: Maybe she's deliberately going easy on me, but every time I dodge, I feel like there won't be a next time for me.

units.rawText: You have no chance to win, yet you refuse to back down.
units.displayText: You have no chance to win, yet you refuse to back down.

spans.text: You have no chance to win, yet you refuse to back down.

units.rawText: Honestly, I don't know whether to describe the fact that you're throwing your life away for a hollow, insubstantial "faith" as "tragic" or "pitiful".
units.displayText: Honestly, I don't know whether to describe the fact that you're throwing your life away for a hollow, insubstantial "faith" as "tragic" or "pitiful".

spans.text: Honestly, I don't know whether to describe the fact that you're throwing your life away for a hollow, insubstantial "faith" as "tragic" or "pitiful".

units.rawText: Because of Persicaria, I cannot back down.
units.displayText: Because of Persicaria, I cannot back down.

spans.text: Because of Persicaria, I cannot back down.

units.rawText: I thought you'd have an interesting story to tell me, but as it turns out you're nothing more than a muddle-headed Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: I thought you'd have an interesting story to tell me, but as it turns out you're nothing more than a muddle-headed Irregular Agent.

spans.text: I thought you'd have an interesting story to tell me, but as it turns out you're nothing more than a muddle-headed Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: And the few minutes that I've earned will become new hope—
units.displayText: And the few minutes that I've earned will become new hope—

spans.text: And the few minutes that I've earned will become new hope—

units.rawText: I've got some good news for you. My orders were to deal with the operand black hole.
units.displayText: I've got some good news for you. My orders were to deal with the operand black hole.

spans.text: I've got some good news for you. My orders were to deal with the operand black hole.

units.rawText: If you save your strength and put it all into running away, I don't mind dealing with you later.
units.displayText: If you save your strength and put it all into running away, I don't mind dealing with you later.

spans.text: If you save your strength and put it all into running away, I don't mind dealing with you later.

units.rawText: Despite saying that, Angelus nocks her bow again and trains it on me.
units.displayText: Despite saying that, Angelus nocks her bow again and trains it on me.

spans.text: Despite saying that, Angelus nocks her bow again and trains it on me.
There's no need for that.
I'm not done talking yet.

units.rawText: You have courage, even when your death is at hand. I'm starting to like you.
units.displayText: You have courage, even when your death is at hand. I'm starting to like you.

spans.text: You have courage, even when your death is at hand. I'm starting to like you.

units.rawText: Because apart from believing in Persicaria—
units.displayText: Because apart from believing in Persicaria—

spans.text: Because apart from believing in Persicaria—

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?
—I also believe in the Exiles!

units.rawText: <size=48>—FIRE!!</size>
units.displayText: —FIRE!!

spans.text: —FIRE!!

units.rawText: Cannonfire erupts from multiple locations and rains down on Angelus. She unconsciously pulls away from me and deploys a barrier to defend herself. Smoke suddenly fills the surroundings.
units.displayText: Cannonfire erupts from multiple locations and rains down on Angelus. She unconsciously pulls away from me and deploys a barrier to defend herself. Smoke suddenly fills the surroundings.

spans.text: Cannonfire erupts from multiple locations and rains down on Angelus. She unconsciously pulls away from me and deploys a barrier to defend herself. Smoke suddenly fills the surroundings.

units.rawText: Croque... at this rate you'll end up hitting the Professor by accident.
units.displayText: Croque... at this rate you'll end up hitting the Professor by accident.

spans.text: Croque... at this rate you'll end up hitting the Professor by accident.

units.rawText: Well, we're cutting it close anyway, so it can't be helped. You can't be so picky at times like these, Anna.
units.displayText: Well, we're cutting it close anyway, so it can't be helped. You can't be so picky at times like these, Anna.

spans.text: Well, we're cutting it close anyway, so it can't be helped. You can't be so picky at times like these, Anna.

units.rawText: Do you know how much of a pain it will be to carry the Professor back if they're heavily injured? Or maybe you should just aim for their head directly and save us all the trouble.
units.displayText: Do you know how much of a pain it will be to carry the Professor back if they're heavily injured? Or maybe you should just aim for their head directly and save us all the trouble.

spans.text: Do you know how much of a pain it will be to carry the Professor back if they're heavily injured? Or maybe you should just aim for their head directly and save us all the trouble.

units.rawText: Uwah, Anna says really scary things sometimes...
units.displayText: Uwah, Anna says really scary things sometimes...

spans.text: Uwah, Anna says really scary things sometimes...

units.rawText: That's because the Professor put themselves and Persicaria in such a dangerous situation.
units.displayText: That's because the Professor put themselves and Persicaria in such a dangerous situation.

spans.text: That's because the Professor put themselves and Persicaria in such a dangerous situation.

units.rawText: If we hadn't showed up, it might really have been goodbye for them.
units.displayText: If we hadn't showed up, it might really have been goodbye for them.

spans.text: If we hadn't showed up, it might really have been goodbye for them.
What took you so long?!

options.rawText:
They say "it might be goodbye" is good luck. 
Better than "I'll get married once I return to my hometown".
options.displayText:
They say "it might be goodbye" is good luck. 
Better than "I'll get married once I return to my hometown".

spans.text:
They say "it might be goodbye" is good luck. 
Better than "I'll get married once I return to my hometown".

units.rawText: Ahem, in any case!
units.displayText: Ahem, in any case!

spans.text: Ahem, in any case!

units.rawText: Prof, the Exile Squad is joining the battle!
units.displayText: Prof, the Exile Squad is joining the battle!

spans.text: Prof, the Exile Squad is joining the battle!

units.rawText: Ahhhh! I wanted to say that!
units.displayText: Ahhhh! I wanted to say that!

spans.text: Ahhhh! I wanted to say that!

units.rawText: The Dolls squeezed on top of Croque's Metal Suit jump off and land on the ground. Antonina lands in front of me and does a simple checkup.
units.displayText: The Dolls squeezed on top of Croque's Metal Suit jump off and land on the ground. Antonina lands in front of me and does a simple checkup.

spans.text: The Dolls squeezed on top of Croque's Metal Suit jump off and land on the ground. Antonina lands in front of me and does a simple checkup.

units.rawText: You're unhurt... What a shame.
units.displayText: You're unhurt... What a shame.

spans.text: You're unhurt... What a shame.

units.rawText: Only you could have thought of sending Neumann's distress signal in its entirety through our channel as a plea for help.
units.displayText: Only you could have thought of sending Neumann's distress signal in its entirety through our channel as a plea for help.

spans.text: Only you could have thought of sending Neumann's distress signal in its entirety through our channel as a plea for help.

units.rawText: Well, a Greater Sanctifier had her eye on me and sending messages was hard.
units.displayText: Well, a Greater Sanctifier had her eye on me and sending messages was hard.

spans.text: Well, a Greater Sanctifier had her eye on me and sending messages was hard.

units.rawText: Automatically sending the message through the scheduled check-in function was the limit of what I could do.
units.displayText: Automatically sending the message through the scheduled check-in function was the limit of what I could do.

spans.text: Automatically sending the message through the scheduled check-in function was the limit of what I could do.

units.rawText: So, instructions please, Professor!
units.displayText: So, instructions please, Professor!

spans.text: So, instructions please, Professor!

options.rawText: Protect the operand black hole and buy Persicaria time!
options.displayText: Protect the operand black hole and buy Persicaria time!

spans.text: Protect the operand black hole and buy Persicaria time!

units.rawText: While I have a lot of questions to ask...for the time being...I've got it. Let's take care of the Greater Sanctifier in front of us first.
units.displayText: While I have a lot of questions to ask...for the time being...I've got it. Let's take care of the Greater Sanctifier in front of us first.

spans.text: While I have a lot of questions to ask...for the time being...I've got it. Let's take care of the Greater Sanctifier in front of us first.

units.rawText: The clouds of dust and smoke clear away. Angelus shows no sign whatsoever that she has been hurt and she looks down on us from a lofty perch.
units.displayText: The clouds of dust and smoke clear away. Angelus shows no sign whatsoever that she has been hurt and she looks down on us from a lofty perch.

spans.text: The clouds of dust and smoke clear away. Angelus shows no sign whatsoever that she has been hurt and she looks down on us from a lofty perch.

units.rawText: Haha, so you were stalling for time just now while waiting for your reinforcements to arrive?
units.displayText: Haha, so you were stalling for time just now while waiting for your reinforcements to arrive?

spans.text: Haha, so you were stalling for time just now while waiting for your reinforcements to arrive?

units.rawText: And to think I didn't notice an attack launched from such close range...
units.displayText: And to think I didn't notice an attack launched from such close range...

spans.text: And to think I didn't notice an attack launched from such close range...

units.rawText: I mean, the operand black hole makes nearly all forms of detection ineffective.
units.displayText: I mean, the operand black hole makes nearly all forms of detection ineffective.

spans.text: I mean, the operand black hole makes nearly all forms of detection ineffective.

units.rawText: The Professor must have made use of that to keep you from noticing Aegis as it approached!
units.displayText: The Professor must have made use of that to keep you from noticing Aegis as it approached!

spans.text: The Professor must have made use of that to keep you from noticing Aegis as it approached!

units.rawText: Hahaha, looks like you aren't entirely brainless either. I really am starting to like you now, Professor.
units.displayText: Hahaha, looks like you aren't entirely brainless either. I really am starting to like you now, Professor.

spans.text: Hahaha, looks like you aren't entirely brainless either. I really am starting to like you now, Professor.

units.rawText: <size=28>Eh?</size>
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: You say that, but you're actually very angry, aren't you?
units.displayText: You say that, but you're actually very angry, aren't you?

spans.text: You say that, but you're actually very angry, aren't you?

units.rawText: Smiling bosses are the scariest.
units.displayText: Smiling bosses are the scariest.

spans.text: Smiling bosses are the scariest.

units.rawText: Since you want to make it a team battle, I'll have to call up some reinforcements of my own.
units.displayText: Since you want to make it a team battle, I'll have to call up some reinforcements of my own.

spans.text: Since you want to make it a team battle, I'll have to call up some reinforcements of my own.

units.rawText: Angelus claps and hordes of Lesser Sanctifiers swarm in.
units.displayText: Angelus claps and hordes of Lesser Sanctifiers swarm in.

spans.text: Angelus claps and hordes of Lesser Sanctifiers swarm in.

units.rawText: Ohhh, that's more like it!
units.displayText: Ohhh, that's more like it!

spans.text: Ohhh, that's more like it!

units.rawText: You didn't call us here to share your grave, did you, Professor?
units.displayText: You didn't call us here to share your grave, did you, Professor?

spans.text: You didn't call us here to share your grave, did you, Professor?
Of course not.

options.rawText: You'd have come even if it was to keep me company in death, right?
options.displayText: You'd have come even if it was to keep me company in death, right?

spans.text: You'd have come even if it was to keep me company in death, right?
What do you think?

units.rawText: I'll be counting on your leadership, then!
units.displayText: I'll be counting on your leadership, then!

spans.text: I'll be counting on your leadership, then!
